newFiddle.description: File menu command that replaces the fiddle with the template for the current Electron version.

newTest.description: File menu command that replaces the fiddle with the test template.

openFolder.description: File menu command that opens a fiddle folder.

openRecent.description: File menu submenu listing recently opened or saved fiddle folders.

save.description: File menu command that saves the fiddle to its folder.

saveAs.description: File menu command that saves the fiddle to a new folder.

saveAsForge.description: File menu command that saves the fiddle as an Electron Forge project. Electron Forge is a product name.

showMe.description: File menu submenu listing the built-in Electron API examples.

closeWindow.description: File menu command that closes the window.

toggleSplit.description: View menu item and command that opens a second editor pane, or closes every pane but the focused one.

moveTabLeft.description: Window menu item and command that moves the current editor tab one place toward the start of the tab row.

moveTabRight.description: Window menu item and command that moves the current editor tab one place toward the end of the tab row.

toggleSidebar.description: Command that shows or hides the file sidebar, as the command palette and the keyboard settings list it. The View menu says Hide sidebar or Show sidebar instead.

toggleConsole.description: Command that shows or hides the output console, as the command palette and the keyboard settings list it. The View menu says Hide console or Show console instead.

showSidebar.description: View menu item, while the file sidebar is hidden, that shows it.

hideSidebar.description: View menu item, while the file sidebar is shown, that hides it.

showConsole.description: View menu item, while the output console is hidden, that shows it.

hideConsole.description: View menu item, while the output console is shown, that hides it.

toggleSoftWrap.description: View menu item and command that turns line wrapping in the editors on or off for this window.

toggleMinimap.description: View menu item and command that shows or hides the editor minimap for this window.

formatDocument.description: Edit menu and editor context menu command that reformats the code in the current editor.

appMenu.description: macOS application menu title. The product name; keep it as is.

about.description: macOS app menu item that opens the about box. {{name}} is the product name.

services.description: macOS app menu submenu with system services.

hide.description: macOS app menu item that hides the app. {{name}} is the product name.

hideOthers.description: macOS app menu item that hides every other app.

showAll.description: macOS app menu item that shows every hidden app.

quit.description: Menu item that quits the app: the macOS app menu, or the File menu on Linux. {{name}} is the product name.

exit.description: File menu item on Windows that quits the app, as Windows apps call it.

newWindow.description: Command that opens a new, empty fiddle window.

reload.description: Command that reloads the current window's view: in the command palette, and in the Develop menu of development builds. Unsaved text is kept.

toggleDevTools.description: Help menu command that opens or closes Chromium's developer tools for the app window.

develop.description: Top-level Develop menu, shown only in development builds of the app, with tools for working on Electron Fiddle itself (as Safari names its menu of developer tools).

toggleMenuBar.description: Develop menu command (development builds only) that shows or hides the application menu bar drawn inside the window's title bar, on any platform, without a restart. Shown with a check mark while that menu bar is visible.

enterFullScreen.description: View menu item, while the window isn't full screen, that makes it full screen.

exitFullScreen.description: View menu item, while the window is full screen, that leaves full screen.

minimize.description: Window menu item that minimizes the focused window.

zoom.description: macOS Window menu item that zooms the window.

openLinkMessage.message: Open this link in your browser?
openLinkMessage.description: Confirmation dialog shown before a link opens in the default browser. The URL is shown below it.

openLink.description: Button in the open-link confirmation dialog that opens the link.

cancel.description: Button that dismisses a dialog without doing anything.

commandPalette.description: Command that opens the command palette, a searchable list of every command, file, version and example.

showTour.description: Help menu command that replays the onboarding tour of the main window.

runMenu.description: Top-level menu with running, packaging and bisecting the fiddle.

runToggle.description: Command that runs the fiddle in Electron, or stops it when it is running, as the command palette and the keyboard settings list it. The Run menu says Run or Stop instead.

run.description: Run menu item, while the fiddle isn't running, that runs it in Electron.

stop.description: Run menu item, while the fiddle runs (or its Electron version downloads or its packages install), that stops it.

packageFiddle.description: Command that packages the fiddle as an app with Electron Forge.

makeFiddle.description: Command that builds installers for the fiddle with Electron Forge.

toggleBisect.description: Command that starts a bisect to find which Electron release changed the fiddle's behavior, or stops the current one. Opens a dialog. The Run menu says Stop bisect while one is running.

stopBisect.description: Run menu item, while a bisect is in progress, that stops it.

preferences.description: Command that opens the settings page in the current window. In the macOS app menu and the File menu elsewhere.

publishToGist.description: Command that publishes the fiddle as a GitHub gist. Opens a dialog.

openGist.description: Command that opens a dialog to load a GitHub gist by URL or ID.

showGistHistory.description: Command that lists the revisions of the loaded gist.

aboutFiddle.description: Help menu command (Windows and Linux) that opens the About panel with the app and Electron versions.

openLogsFolder.description: Help menu command that shows the folder with the app's log files.

copyDiagnostics.description: Help menu command that copies versions, OS details and changed settings (without secrets) for a bug report.

openFiddleRepository.description: Help menu command that opens the Electron Fiddle source repository in the browser.

openElectronRepository.description: Help menu command that opens the Electron source repository in the browser.

reportIssue.description: Help menu command that opens the Electron Fiddle issue tracker in the browser.

actualSize.description: View menu item that resets the window's zoom level to 100%.

zoomIn.description: View menu item that makes everything in the window larger.

zoomOut.description: View menu item that makes everything in the window smaller.

clearConsole.description: Command that removes every line from the output console. In the Edit menu, context menus and the command palette.

formatAll.description: Edit menu command that reformats the code in every file of the fiddle.

formatSelection.description: Edit menu and editor context menu command that reformats only the selected code.

goToDefinition.description: Editor context menu command that jumps to where the symbol under the cursor is defined.

findReferences.description: Editor context menu command that lists every place the symbol under the cursor is used.

toggleTabFocus.description: Accessibility command in the View menu that turns tab-focus mode on or off: while it's on, the Tab key moves keyboard focus out of the editor instead of inserting a tab. Tab is the key's name.

reloadAllWindows.description: Command that reloads every open window's view, for example to apply a new editor font: a button in Settings, the command palette, and the Develop menu of development builds. Unsaved text is kept.

inspectElement.description: Context menu item, only in development builds, that opens the developer tools at the clicked element.
